policy: Documentary dossiers in chronological or textual context, not a leaderboard, best-fit selection or a count of fulfilled verses. A source recording an accusation is distinct from a source recording conduct.

sources.access_scope: Opening survival narrative and attributed audience responses consulted. Not an audience survey or medical record.

dossiers.title: Butler aftermath: reaction, religious explanation and mission
dossiers.documented_record: The July 18, 2024 speech narrates spectators believing Trump dead and then recognizing survival. The January 2025 inauguration connects survival to a stated mission.
dossiers.comparison_question: How does the author's Revelation 13:3 comparison distinguish the wound, apparent survival, reported reactions, religious explanation and later political use?
dossiers.scope_limit: A speaker's report of spectators' thoughts is not a survey. Applause, gratitude, adherence and worship are separate observations.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Account publication and the circulation of sacred imagery
dossiers.documented_record: The May 2, 2025 account archive records publication of the papal portrait. The merged media register separates this from other publications and sharing relationships.
dossiers.comparison_question: Who originates an image, which account selects it, what caption is added, and which institution amplifies it?
dossiers.scope_limit: The first beast, the promoting agent and the image are not the same role. Image content does not measure viewers' belief. Unverified image descriptions retain their limits.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Claims about national rescue and legal authority
dossiers.documented_record: A February 15, 2025 account post links saving the country to not violating law.
dossiers.comparison_question: What exception does the maxim suggest, and is a particular later action expressly defended through it?
dossiers.scope_limit: The post alone identifies neither a case nor a lawful exemption. A claim, an implemented act and a legal ruling require different records.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Conditional food access and material dependence
dossiers.documented_record: The existing November 4, 2025 record preserves a statement linking SNAP payments to government reopening, alongside the subsequent compliance clarification.
dossiers.comparison_question: Is the condition imposed on recipients, legislators, distribution institutions or another party, and what actually happens to access?
dossiers.scope_limit: A financing condition is not automatically a personal-allegiance test. Preserve court orders, exceptions and actual payments before describing a transaction rule.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Threats, negotiations and observed military actions
dossiers.documented_record: A July 2018 Twitter statement addresses Iran's president and threatens consequences for further threats.
dossiers.comparison_question: What addressee, trigger, response and interval does the statement specify, and which later events independently establish the outcome?
dossiers.scope_limit: A threat is not a strike. A treaty or negotiation does not by itself establish deceptive intent or the gathering described in Revelation.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: An earlier presidential survival-and-return account
dossiers.documented_record: On April 28, 1981, Reagan thanked people for prayers and support, acknowledged others injured, described improved health, and advocated his economic program.
dossiers.comparison_question: Which parts of the sequence are shared with other public-survival narratives, and which are documented only in one case?
dossiers.scope_limit: A recurring feature can support a typological question without establishing identical conduct or a unique final fulfillment. No whole-life moral judgment is inferred.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Napoleon represented through Revelation 13 in 1808
dossiers.documented_record: Princeton catalogues an 1808 etching explicitly applying Revelation 13 imagery to Napoleon.
dossiers.comparison_question: Which elements did the historical illustrator choose, and how did the image function in its own political setting?
dossiers.scope_limit: This is direct evidence of a historical comparison being made, not evidence that every depicted analogy was true. The catalogue's number associations are not recomputed as identity tests.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Institutional loyalty in the 1934 state-official oath
dossiers.documented_record: The August 20, 1934 state-official oath names Hitler as its object of fidelity and obedience while also referring to duties and law.
dossiers.comparison_question: What changes when an institution attaches loyalty to a named ruler, and how does that differ from a public religious image or ordinary political support?
dossiers.scope_limit: The source documents a specific oath, not the proposition that every leader with supporters has the same institutional structure. No unsupported claim about who called Hitler Antichrist is added.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: A reported accusation concerning a magazine cover
dossiers.documented_record: A 1993 report records readers interpreting Clinton's magazine-cover presentation as Antichrist imagery.
dossiers.comparison_question: What is evidence about an accusation, and what separate evidence would be needed about the person or institution accused?
dossiers.scope_limit: A hostile interpretation of cover design is not a documented government mechanism.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.comparison_question: What does the existence of the claim establish about reception, as distinct from policy or prophetic identification?
dossiers.scope_limit: Reported belief is not proof of its object. No result is converted into a politician's score or a comparative ranking.

dossiers.comparison_question: How should an accusation's source and setting be preserved before treating it as a precedent?
dossiers.scope_limit: This record establishes that an accusation was made, not that the accusation was true or representative.

dossiers.title: Royal and divine representation in an Egyptian artifact
dossiers.documented_record: The Met describes a statue joining King Sahure with a divine figure offering life, using royal protection and authority imagery.
dossiers.comparison_question: Which visual and institutional relationships are comparable, and which depend on a different religion, period or form of government?
dossiers.scope_limit: Sahure is not identified with Exodus's unnamed pharaoh. Sacred kingship is not automatically identical to modern fascism or a contemporary presidency.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.

dossiers.title: Russia policy: dated statements rather than a moral scale
dossiers.documented_record: Obama's March 20, 2014 statement announced additional sanctions on Russia. Trump's July 16, 2018 Helsinki statement presented engagement and dialogue as serving peace.
dossiers.comparison_question: What instruments, stated objectives, implementation and observable consequences belong to each episode?
dossiers.scope_limit: These statements are neither a complete policy history nor an assessment of which president was better. An author's theological evaluation must not replace the factual policy record.
dossiers.author_interpretation: Micah Blumberg proposes a contemporary First Beast reading; this dossier preserves documentary material without assigning a political identity or ranking.
